If the turbidity is 100 NTU or more, the central control room temporarily suspends water intake."},

    {"source_unit_id": "P11", "text": "At 9:00 p.m., when the raw water turbidity drops below 30 NTU, the central control room lifts the high-turbidity response stage and returns the monitoring interval to 30 min."},
    {"source_unit_id": "P12", "text": "The central control room compiles the incident details and reports them to the city hall water supply division."},
